title: 第15章 柳嫣然的心声第16章 太苍武王万里血河掌
content_zh:
第一卷第15章柳嫣然的心声
“嗯。”
柳嫣然轻轻点头。
“你为何会与苏墨交手？”
林尘凝视着她，心情复杂。
柳嫣然温柔一笑：“苏墨老贼欺你，我怎能不管！”
“当时，我得知你被废武魂，被逐出宗门，便立刻赶来灵剑宗，想找苏墨讨个说法。”
“我与苏墨定下赌约，只要能接下他一掌，他就任由我带你离开，绝不阻拦。”
“苏墨老贼很自负，但他一掌没能打死我，后来，我便找到了你。”
闻言，林尘心中百感交集。
“嫣然，你为何不让武极宗长辈出面？”
“当时师尊在闭关修炼，我不想打扰他，便自己来了。”
柳嫣然轻声道。
林尘心中感动，原来，柳嫣然默默为他做了这么多！
柳嫣然说得轻巧，但，苏墨是灵海九重巅峰的强者，服用了天灵丹以后，很可能已经突破到灵海之上。
柳嫣然与他对战，其中艰辛，可想而知。
当日，柳嫣然带林尘回到武极宗以后，便匆匆去闭关。
如今看来，她闭关根本不是为了修炼，而是去疗伤。
“嫣然，谢谢！”
林尘心中有很多话想说，但千言万语，只有一句谢谢。

最难消受美人恩。
“尘哥，都是过去的事了，不用想太多的。”
“我们早就定下了婚约，应该互相帮助的。”
柳嫣然美丽的脸上，露出一抹动人笑容。
“嫣然，别说话了，我助你逼出蝎毒。”
林尘面色沉凝，体内灵力爆发而出。
“尘哥，不必为我损耗太多灵力，我没有大碍。”
柳嫣然急道。
林尘并未回应，直接召唤出至尊神龙武魂！
一道血色龙影，盘旋在林尘身边，恐怖的武魂威压释放而出。
柳嫣然脸色微变，没想到，林尘竟然能再度觉醒武魂！
她惊讶之余，心中欣喜无比，替林尘感到高兴。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 15 Liu Yanran’s Voice
"Yeah."
Liu Yanran nodded lightly.
"Why did you fight with Su Mo?"
Lin Chen stared at her with mixed emotions.
Liu Yanran smiled softly: "Old thief Su Mo is bullying you, how can I ignore it!"
"At that time, when I learned that you had been deposed and expelled from the sect, I immediately rushed to Lingjian Sect to seek an explanation from Su Mo."
"I made a bet with Su Mo. As long as you can take one of his palms, he will let me take you away without stopping you."
"Old thief Su Mo is very conceited, but he couldn't kill me with one strike. Later, I found you."
Hearing this, Lin Chen had mixed feelings in his heart.
"Yanran, why don't you let the elders of Wuji Sect come forward?"
"The master was practicing in seclusion at that time. I didn't want to disturb him, so I came here myself."
Liu Yanran said softly.
Lin Chen was moved. It turned out that Liu Yanran had silently done so much for him!
Liu Yanran said it lightly, but Su Mo was a strong man at the ninth level of the spiritual sea. After taking the Tianling Pill, he might have broken through to the spiritual sea.
Liu Yanran fought against him, and one can imagine the hardships involved.
That day, after Liu Yanran brought Lin Chen back to Wuji Sect, they hurriedly went to retreat.
Now it seems that her seclusion is not for cultivation at all, but to heal her wounds.
"Yanran, thank you!"
Lin Chen had a lot to say in his heart, but out of a thousand words, he could only say thank you.
It is most difficult to accept the kindness of a beautiful woman.
"Brother Chen, it's all in the past, don't think too much about it."
"We have made an engagement long ago and should help each other."
A touching smile appeared on Liu Yanran's beautiful face.
"Yanran, stop talking, I'll help you force out the scorpion poison."
Lin Chen's face was solemn, and the spiritual power in his body burst out.
"Brother Chen, don't waste too much spiritual power on me, I'm fine."
Liu Yanran said anxiously.
Lin Chen did not respond and directly summoned the Supreme Divine Dragon Spirit!
A bloody dragon shadow hovered around Lin Chen, and the terrifying pressure of the martial spirit was released.
Liu Yanran's expression changed slightly. She didn't expect that Lin Chen could awaken his martial spirit again!
While she was surprised, she was extremely happy and felt happy for Lin Chen.
